pages.title: Aspects
pages.text: The original Arcane Archives aspect assignments are available to Thaumaturge scans and alchemy. Radiant Quartz supplies Praecantatio.

$(br2)$(bold)Rivertear$() If you have a $(l:arcanearchives:gems/rivertear)Rivertear$() somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gem_socket)Gem Socket$()), right clicking a Crucible will refill it with water.
pages.title: Crucible

pages.text: Raw Quartz Clusters and Braziers of Hoarding stabilize Thaumaturge infusion. Place matching blocks in mirrored pairs at the same height around the matrix. A Cluster pair supplies 0.15 stability and a Brazier pair 0.2 before Thaumaturge diminishing returns; unmatched blocks reduce stability.
pages.title: Infusion
